build_fourier_position_encoding: build a Fourier position encoding module with configurable frequency bands and resolution for spatial data
build_trainable_position_encoding: build a trainable position encoding module with learnable Haiku parameters for a given index dimension
generate_fourier_features: generate Fourier frequency position embeddings from N-D point coordinates with sine and cosine bands
build_linear_positions: build a linear position index grid for an N-D array with configurable output value range
build_position_encoding: build a position encoding of type trainable or fourier with optional linear projection to a target dimension
